questions.q:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

In 79 A.D., the Mount Vesuvius blew / its top, burying the ancient / cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum.
o: In 79 A.D., the Mount Vesuvius blew
questions.s:
We use the with the names of some mountains: the Matterhorn, the Jungfrau.

We do not use the if the name includes Mount or Mountain: Mount Olympus, Brokeback Mountain.

So, 'the' before 'Mount Vesuvius' needs to be removed in order to rectify the error.

The correct sentence is: In 79 A.D., Mount Vesuvius blew its top, burying the ancient cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum.

Hence, option (a) is the answer.

Yahan kehna hai ki India ke president ki constitution power limitless hai isliye 'president of India' ka constitutional power par possession banane ke liye apostophe (') lagega.

Note :- Agar is sentence ka structure esa hota toh better hota 'the constitutional power of the president of India is limitless'

questions.q: The carpenter replaced the table's legs with shorter ones to accommodate the lower height of the chairs.
questions.s:
‘Table’s legs’ should be changed into ‘legs of the table’. An apostrophe is generally not used with non-living things.

Therefore, the correct sentence would be: “The carpenter replaced the legs of the table with shorter ones to accommodate the lower height of the chairs.”
